credits.title: Lenin Pandiyan
credits.overview: Set alongside on the riverbanks of Maanamadurai in the Sivagangai district, the premise is about a very gullible, innocent old couple in their late 60s, 70s who inadvertently get intertwined in the political lobby of sand mining which is currently a major issue in the local district.

credits.title: Bison Kaalamaadan
credits.overview: A young man fights to overcome violence plaguing his village and succeed as a professional kabaddi player.

credits.title: Maareesan
credits.overview: A petty thief embarks on a road trip with an elderly man suffering from memory loss under deceptive pretenses. As they journey across Tamil Nadu, the promise of an easy con unravels into a quietly shifting connection, with both men hiding secrets of their own.
